data.name: Gorilla Tag Contagion
data.detailed_description:
From the minds of the cultural smash Gorilla Tag comes an all new way to Become Monke…

Outlast the Outbreak

Gorilla Tag Contagion is a co-op survival roguelite that casts you as an employee of the mysterious Gorilla Corp. Trapped by an experiment gone awry, you and your co-workers must battle through company sites filled with hordes of mutated animals, insects and worse. You must keep building your arsenal and collect weaponry if you want to defeat the ever-growing flood of creatures. It is up to you to end the infection spreading across the land… will you prevail?

The Joy of Movement

Monke can fight, but they live to move. Jump, bounce, wallrun, slide and roll your way through forests, caves, ice and fire. The contagion is rising and its poison is spreading before your eyes, so you’ll need to keep climbing to rise above it, or use your height to dive down and gather loot at ground level. Climb trees, swing on ropes and ziplines, bounce on trampolines, do anything you can to stay ahead of the swarm and gain the advantage. Rescue new Monke with unique movement styles that you can play as and experience the action in a whole new way.

Endless Upgrades

Luckily, you have the finest Monke scientists at the ready to build you weapons, equipment and unique ability upgrades. Collect resources that they will use to add strength to your attacks, special moves and ultimately enhance you with air jumps, jetpacks, spin moves and dashes. Some weapons even combine with moves to turn your acrobatics into a deadly flurry of attacks. There are even gadgets that use your kinetic energy to power incredible effects. It’s up to you to discover your playstyle and create a build that can lay the enemy to waste.

Team up with Friends

It’s a tough world, but you don’t have to go it alone. Join up with 3 other Monke and take on the Contagion together. Choose a Monke. Share the loot. Discover cooperative items that make you stronger together than ever. You can even tag each other to give your companion additional buffs.

Features

  • Short, intense sessions with interesting player upgrade choices

  • Multiple characters, each with unique movement capabilities and weaponry

  • Over 20 unique levels across multiple environments, each with multiple missions to keep the experience fresh

  • Progression over many sessions, with a campaign and story that expands the world of Gorilla Tag

  • Endless challenge and opportunities to create unique builds

  • Easy cooperative play between 4 friends online

data.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies! Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Team up with other Monke in coop and outlast the outbreak, together!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5 8400
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 1060
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Better than i5 8400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Better than Geforce 1060
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
